meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文章、笔记或选题变成画面自创的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字素材,想快速做成讲解视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn articles, notes, or a topic into an explainer video with invented visuals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have text material and want a quick explainer video.

howto.what: 把一段文章、笔记或话题变成无真人出镜的解说视频：逐帧设计视觉（排版、图形、图表），依次产出分镜稿 STORYBOARD.md、口播稿 SCRIPT.md 和成片 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你给出一段文本，想做话题讲解、概念拆解、教程等解说视频时接管；若要做基于网站的推广/导览视频则不适用，意图不明会先走 /hyperframes。

howto.what_en: Turns an article, notes, or topic into a faceless explainer video: every visual is invented per scene (typography, graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Outputs a storyboard, a script, and renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Use when you give it text for a topic explainer, concept breakdown, how-to, or listicle. Not for website-based videos (/product-launch-video); unclear cases go to /hyperframes.
